name: Icon
description: Local SVG icon resolved by variant and name.

notes: Meaningful icons support an accessible label

usage.summary: Icon renders a span with an SVG CSS mask, not an inline svg. Assets are application-owned. Load guide:icon-setup for IconProvider, static assets and on-demand routes.

rules.title: Configure the asset contract
rules.description: Serve {asset-url}/{variant}/{id}.svg. Default asset-url is /ui/icons; a variant prop or provider default-variant is required. Missing assets warn in development.

rules.title: Size icons through their slot
rules.description: Default size uses --icon-size with a 20px standalone fallback. Button/Select/Expand/Badge slots set this variable. An explicit size prop overrides it.

rules.title: Use explicit per-icon overrides
rules.description: An Icon asset-url overrides the provider resolver for that icon. Otherwise resolve-source wins over the provider base URL. Icon IDs come from the installed application collection, not a universal built-in set.
